name: Sketch
source: A Sketch type monster girl. [url=http://vndb.org/c10474]Leo[/url] finds this Sketch in a dungeon. Her drawings come to life and although she tries hard everything she draws looks like childish scribblings. She can also attack with her enormous pencil.
